fixed_instructions: Position the yellow stamping tool on Olive, apply pressure
Lift the plastic seal with handle and press onto Lime
With the right arm, secure the palm-sized stamping seal and mark Tan.
Grab the yellow seal with ridged grip and press Lime
Press the seal for imprinting onto Red
With the right arm, secure the seal with raised rounded edges and mark Orange.
Set the small seal with round base on Indigo
Stamp Orange after grabbing the seal with smooth handle
the right arm holds the yellow stamping tool, presses Black
Place the hand-sized rectangular brown seal onto Brown after grabbing.
Position the yellow stamping tool over Gray and stamp
Press the plastic seal with handle firmly onto Black
Lift the reddish seal with light markings and press onto Tan
Take the red seal for stamping and stamp it on Green.
Grab the hand-sized red and black seal, align it with Cyan
Pick the yellow seal and press on Navy
the right arm picks the round yellow seal base, stamps Indigo
Position the seal with white engraving on Black, apply pressure
the left arm holds the yellow seal, presses Orange
Use the right arm to lift the yellow seal, then stamp Cyan.
